description: DB migrations 11-12 + DB types + Staff Groups API+UI + Media attachments on feedback. Independent of FEATs 002-006 except that DB types must be written first (they're in this FEAT).
steps:
2. Create supabase/migrations/20261023000012_feedback_media.sql:
```sql
ALTER TABLE feedback ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS media_url text;
```

4. Add manage_rewards and manage_automations permissions to src/lib/rbac.ts:
  - In Permission union type add: `| "manage_rewards"` and `| "manage_automations"`
  - In PERMISSION_MAP add:
    `manage_rewards: ["admin", "hr"],`
    `manage_automations: ["admin", "hr"],`

5. Create src/app/api/pulse/staff-groups/route.ts:
  - GET: returns all staff_groups ordered by name, requires session
  - POST: creates a staff_group, requires session + name (non-empty) + member_ids (array of valid user UUIDs, min 2, all active). Validates member_ids against users table. Returns { id }.

6. Create src/features/settings/components/StaffGroupsClient.tsx (client component):
  - Props: `{ initial: StaffGroup[]; users: { id: string; name: string }[] }`
  - Shows list of groups (name, member count, delete button)
  - 'New group' button opens SimpleModal with: name input + multi-select of users (same style as DepartmentsClient.tsx inline-add pattern)
  - On save POSTs to /api/pulse/staff-groups, on success calls router.refresh()
  - On delete calls DELETE /api/pulse/staff-groups with { id } in body, on success removes from local state
  - Add DELETE handler to route.ts (requires session; verifies group created_by === session.user.id OR admin/hr)
  - Use toast from react-hot-toast for success/error (same as DepartmentsClient.tsx)

7. Create src/features/settings/components/StaffGroupsPage.tsx (server component):
  - Fetches staff groups and active users via supabaseAdmin
  - Guards with can(session.user.role, 'manage_recognition_campaigns') — same HR/admin gate
  - Renders StaffGroupsClient
  - Renders SetPageHeader with title 'Staff Groups', icon 'solar:users-group-rounded-broken'

9. Add 'Staff Groups' to SETTINGS_NAV in src/features/settings/components/SettingsShell.tsx under 'Organization' group:
  `{ id: 'staff-groups', label: 'Staff Groups', icon: 'solar:users-group-rounded-broken', href: '/settings/staff-groups' }`

10. Extend SendFeedbackForm (src/features/pulse/feedback/components/SendFeedbackForm.tsx) with staff group tab:
  - Add prop `groups: { id: string; name: string; member_ids: string[] }[]` to Props interface
  - Add state: `const [recipientMode, setRecipientMode] = useState<'individual'|'group'>('individual')`
  - When visibility === 'public', show two sub-tabs: 'Individual' and 'Staff group' (only if groups.length > 0)
  - When 'Staff group' mode: show a select of groups. On selection, setRecipientIds(selectedGroup.member_ids)
  - When switching back to 'Individual', reset recipientIds to [users[0]?.id ?? '']
  - Pass expanded member IDs as recipientIds to existing submit() — no API changes needed

11. Extend FeedbackPage.tsx server component to fetch groups and pass to SendFeedbackForm:
  - src/features/pulse/feedback/components/FeedbackPage.tsx: add supabaseAdmin.from('staff_groups').select('id,name,member_ids') query, pass as groups prop to SendFeedbackForm

12. Add media URL field to SendFeedbackForm:
  - Add state: `const [mediaUrl, setMediaUrl] = useState('')`
  - When visibility === 'public', below the message textarea add an optional 'Image / GIF URL' text input (placeholder 'https://media.giphy.com/…')
  - Below the input add a small Giphy search: a text input 'Search Giphy' + search button that calls `https://api.giphy.com/v1/gifs/search?api_key=dc6zaTOxFJmzC&q=QUERY&limit=8&rating=g` (fetch from client), shows 8 small gif thumbnails in a grid, clicking one sets mediaUrl
  - Include mediaUrl in the POST body: add `media_url: mediaUrl || null` to the JSON
  - Update /api/pulse/feedback/route.ts to accept media_url from request body and pass it on to the feedback insert

13. Show media in FeedbackWall cards (src/features/pulse/feedback/components/FeedbackWall.tsx): - The FeedbackWithUsers type in actions.ts extends Feedback which now has media_url; no type change needed there - In the article element, after the message paragraph, add: `{item.media_url && }` - The FeedbackWall already receives FeedbackWithUsers[] — just render the field
acceptance_criteria: npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 with no errors after this FEAT
StaffGroup, RewardCatalogue, RewardRedemption, Milestone, AutomationRule, EngagementNotificationPreferences type aliases exported from src/types/database.ts
manage_rewards and manage_automations appear in Permission type and PERMISSION_MAP in src/lib/rbac.ts
SETTINGS_NAV in SettingsShell.tsx includes staff-groups entry
SendFeedbackForm accepts groups prop and renders group tab when groups.length > 0
SendFeedbackForm renders media URL input and Giphy search for public feedback
FeedbackWall renders img tag when media_url is set on a feedback item
findings: All 13 acceptance criteria met. tsc --noEmit exits 0. Migration 11 uses auth.users ref (not public.users) to match Supabase convention. staff_groups API route created with GET/POST/DELETE. StaffGroupsClient uses checkbox multi-select matching DepartmentsClient patterns. SendFeedbackForm extended with group tab (shown only when groups.length > 0 and visibility=public) and Giphy search picker. FeedbackWall renders img when media_url present. manage_rewards and manage_automations added to rbac. All new table types plus type aliases exported from database.ts.
